## Sources

## Description

As Tfa041 but emphasizing the diagnostic-only phase: the analyzer must detect the spot classification and emit a structured warning containing the spot's 3D location (`Pnt`) before any healer is invoked. Typical fixture: an ADVANCED_FACE whose outer EDGE_LOOP encloses a sub-tolerance area (e.g., a 0.001 x 0.001 mm square at the origin) — same sub-precision spot pattern as Tfa040/Tfa041/Tfa043. Lets users inspect spot positions and decide on tolerance policy.

## Reproducer recipe

As Tfa041 — a sub-precision spot ADVANCED_FACE.

## Expected kernel behavior

emit the diagnostic with the location attribute; do not modify the face.

## Notes

Pure-diagnostic counterpart of FixSpotFace.
